listings.summary: Summer public health leadership program offering clinical, research, and community engagement experiences focused on maternal and child health and reducing health disparities.

listings.title: Paid Summer Research Opportunity in Time-Domain Astronomy (RENEW-Midwest)
listings.summary: 10-week summer research detecting kilonova events in large astronomical surveys using Python data analysis, with faculty mentoring from Benedictine and University of Michigan.

listings.title: The Amgen Scholars Program
listings.summary: Ten-week full-time summer lab research with faculty mentors, plus weekly seminars, graduate school preparation, and a final research paper and poster presentation.

listings.title: IRES: Development of the Neutron Optics Parity and Time Violation Experiment in Japan
listings.summary: Summer research internship at Nagoya University, Japan, developing hardware for the NOPTREX experiment investigating matter/antimatter asymmetry, with academic-year training beforehand.

listings.title: STEM Summer Scholars Institute (SSI)
listings.summary: Eight-week summer program at IU Bloomington and IUPUI where scholars from IU and partner MSIs conduct research with faculty, plus colloquia, technical writing, and GRE preparation.

listings.title: NSF Center for Genetically Encoded Materials Summer Undergraduate Research Program (C-GEM SURP)
listings.summary: 10-week summer program where undergraduates conduct individual research at the chemistry-biology interface in C-GEM faculty labs, with mentorship and professional development.
